title: Victory over Sihon, King of Heshbon
description: Moses sent a peace proposal from the wilderness of Kedemoth to Sihon, king of the Amorites in Heshbon, asking for safe passage. But Sihon refused, for the Lord had made his spirit stubborn and his heart unyielding. Israel defeated him at Jahaz, captured all his cities from Aroer by the Arnon River to Gilead, and devoted them to destruction, but they stayed away from the land of the Ammonites along the Jabbok.
